France May Back Knot for ECB President, Seeks Chief Economist Role

France is reportedly considering backing former Dutch central bank chief Klaas Knot to succeed Christine Lagarde as the European Central Bank (ECB) president. This potential support is contingent on a French candidate securing the role of ECB chief economist. Sources cited by Reuters indicate that this exchange is a key consideration in the succession planning. Other individuals mentioned as potential candidates for the ECB presidency include Pablo Hernández de Cos, Joachim Nagel, and Nadia Calvino.
